contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ COS V PP (S P Q R OPTIMO PRINC)

A silver plated copper-alloy contemporary copy of a denarius of Trajan, AD98-117 (Reece period 5). This coin is copying a coin minted in Rome, post AD103. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //DAC CAP. Reverse legend reads COS V PP (S P Q R OPTIMO PRINC). See RIC II, p.250, c.f.no.96. Obverse shows laureate bust right.
